children: Icelandair ehf. and the Union of Icelandic Aircraft Maintenance Technicians (FVFI) have agreed on a new collective-bargaining agreement for the period 1 January 2026 to 1 September 2028. FVFI will now present the collective-bargaining agreement to its members who will vote on the agreement. The result of the vote is expected on 1 December 2026.
Asdis Petursdottir, Director Communications. E-mail: asdis@icelandair.is
